column1: # Reference words: labels that make a number a business number, not personal data
# (order, invoice, tracking, SKU ...). One entry per line, `#` comments, blank lines ignored.
# A trailing `*` lets the word take suffixes (`order*`: `orders`, `Bestellnummer`).
# Entries are written without accents; both spellings match (`rendeles*` matches
# Optional second column: `both` (the default: the rules check and the NER check read it),
# `rules` (the rules check only) or `ner` (the NER check only), `weak` (LAB-1293: a poor
# negative cue such as an amount or generic reference word, honored by the rules check only;
# the NER check ignores it, as before).
